description: Connect ChatGPT to your xMatix organization to find business records, analyze data, run saved reports and dashboards, and search platform knowledge. With organization approval and the required user permissions, create or update records and manage metadata, layouts, workflows, scripts and integrations. Sign in with your xMatix account and choose the organizations to connect. An administrator must enable External Assistants; write and setup access require opt-in. Access depends on connection scopes, organization settings and the permissions enforced by xMatix. Authorized automation and integration operations can change records and contact configured external services. Enter integration credentials in the authenticated xMatix application, not in chat.
